title: Record the initial value behind the restored coefficient
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 9564, register 357 holds `1` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- Event 9544 writes `-2` times register 359 while that register still holds its initial `1`. Event 9561 scales the result by `-1/2`.
- Event 9564 adds the resulting `1` into register 360. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
